name: Roka
notes: Deep trust. They function as a single system: he moves life, she preserves it.

name: Kiri
notes: Concerned about her wandering nature, but trusts her instincts.

name: Doran
notes: Respects his labor knowledge; often frustrated when injuries come from overwork.

name: Mara
notes: Quiet cooperation. Mara understands loss; Ena understands damage before loss.

name: Nara
notes: Respectful but distant. Disagrees about spiritual explanations for physical conditions.

name: Toma
notes: Occasional collaboration when rituals involve animals; he listens more than he believes.

name: Ikan
notes: Worries about his recklessness near dangerous terrain.
